title: The European trip: London, Sweden and Copenhagen
summary: Watkins enjoyed the tour, staying close to the band, with cold weather in London and Sweden and a warm reception in Copenhagen.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you enjoy that trip last year?

Oh, I had a wonderful, most enjoyable time I ever had in my life. I was kind of leery, you know, because you sit down and look at television and see different things about what's going to happen over there. And you hear the news about different things that's going on. Well, I stuck close with the band. Sure. Yeah, none of them, the only man that got around was Joe Robichaud. He about the only man that, you know, revealed away from the band going around the city and all that. He tried several times to get me to go out with him. I said, no, Joe. I said, thank you very much. But I think I prefer to stay here because I have to look after drag anyhow. And if I go anywhere drag, it's going to be world half to death, you know.
Yeah. You had a lot of cold weather there too, I guess. Oh, plenty of cold weather.

But it wasn't as bad in London. It was real cold but no snow. Very little snow they had. But after we left then and went over into Europe and went to Sweden, I never seen so much snow. Good God Almighty, they had some snow over there. Jesus. Well, Copenhagen was dry, practically dry. There was no snow but it was cold. It was a dry cold but it was a wonderful place. Yeah. And I must say I really enjoyed myself over there in Copenhagen. And people were just as nice over there to us as if we was a Danish ourself, you know what I mean? Yeah. They really showed us a wonderful time and looking forward to seeing us all come back again. But every time I hear from them they all ask me about Jim and Howard. Well, I just don't know what the devil would say to them about it because…
Yeah, I know how you feel.

I wouldn't want them to think that the fellas, you know, just quit the band that's dropping on the store or something like that. So, I said, well, I just won't mention nothing about them. Just tell them I saw them and they're doing nicely and how things is here, you know, and that's all.
